description: Main behavioral-computation figure. The preferred radius/dynamic-speed model family is compared with four independently labelled specified alternatives; free allocation provides a modest held-out improvement over fixed-allocation RV.
model_scope: AM1-AM4 denote exact tested formulations, not exhaustive mechanism classes.

A.claim: Radius, duration, and dynamic speed are treated as parallel candidate setpoint coordinates before held-out model comparison.
A.rvrho_allocation: Delta r=rho Delta s; Delta t=-(1-rho) Delta s

RVrho_minus_FULL.definition: RVrho RMSE minus Full affine RMSE

inference.correlation_multiple_comparison: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR across the two planned Pearson correlations in the left AM2 subpanel.
inference.noise_multiple_comparison: No adjustment: the right AM2 subpanel contains one planned paired comparison.

blocked_cv_inference.test_current: Eight one-sided subject-level Wilcoxon signed-rank tests of delta R2 greater than zero, Holm-corrected across four history models and two outputs.
blocked_cv_inference.test_beyond_lag1: Two-sided subject-level Wilcoxon signed-rank against zero.

H_AM3.p_value_display: Blocked-CV P values are omitted from the panel and reserved for the figure legend.

off_scale_display.marker: Downward triangle at the lower axis boundary
off_scale_display.legend_note: One radius held-out delta-R-squared value falls below the displayed axis; the triangle marks its truncated position and the exact value is reported in the figure legend.

H_AM3.interpretation: No tested history variant produced a positive held-out gain that survived Holm correction.

I_AM4.display: Independent narrow right-hand boxplot; dashed reference line denotes slope 2/3.
